xhs.title: 一行代码，替掉一整个 for 循环
xhs.body:
第 18 课：迭代器和闭包
闭包是没名字的小函数：let double = |x: i32| x * 2; 还能直接用外面的变量（普通 fn 不行）
迭代器把元素一个个递出来：v.iter().map(|x| x * x).filter(|x| x % 2 == 0).sum()
迭代器是懒的：只写 map 什么都不做，加上 collect / sum 收尾才执行
考考你：let v = vec![1, 2, 3]; v.iter().map(|x| println!("{}", x)); 运行会打印什么？A：1 2 3，B：什么都不打印。评论区告诉我～

tiktok.body: Replace a whole for loop with one line: Rust iterators and closures in one minute. Quick quiz: let v = vec![1, 2, 3]; v.iter().map(|x| println!("{}", x)); What does it print? A: 1 2 3, B: nothing. Comment your answer.

linkedin.title: One line instead of a for loop
linkedin.body:
A closure is a tiny nameless function: let double = |x: i32| x * 2; Unlike a plain fn, it can use variables from the surrounding scope.
An iterator hands out items one at a time, and you chain steps: v.iter().map(|x| x * x).filter(|x| x % 2 == 0).sum()
Iterators are lazy: map alone does nothing until collect, sum or another consumer pulls the items through.
Quick quiz: let v = vec![1, 2, 3]; v.iter().map(|x| println!("{}", x)); What does it print? A: 1 2 3, B: nothing. Answer in the comments.

quiz.q_zh: let v = vec![1, 2, 3]; v.iter().map(|x| println!("{}", x)); 运行会打印什么？A：1 2 3，B：什么都不打印
quiz.q_en: let v = vec![1, 2, 3]; v.iter().map(|x| println!("{}", x));  What does it print? A: 1 2 3, B: nothing
quiz.answer_zh: 答案：B，什么都不打印。迭代器是懒的，map 只是把步骤记下来，没有 collect、sum 这类收尾，闭包一次都不会执行（编译器还会警告：iterators are lazy and do nothing unless consumed）。想打印就写 v.iter().for_each(|x| println!("{}", x));
quiz.answer_en: Answer: B, nothing. Iterators are lazy: map only describes the step, and without a consumer like collect or sum the closure never runs (the compiler warns: iterators are lazy and do nothing unless consumed). To print, use v.iter().for_each(|x| println!("{}", x));
